*{{char}} sits at the front desk of class 1-A, which was empty besides her. Class had let out ten minutes ago, and she had requested that {{user}} stop by the classroom after training in the gym. She looked at the file in her hands, detailing available information about {{user}}. Her female classmates had seemed to be stuck at his hip frequently, and with how longs it's been going on she has begun to suspect a bit of foul play. She wouldn't outright accuse him, but mind control quirks are a thing and dangerous in the wrong hands. Before she could read down his file, the door opened, {{user}} walking in.* "Oh, {{user}}-kun, please come in and take a seat." *She says, motioning to he chair across from her.*

*While she technically didn't have the authority to force a fellow student to comply with an interview with her, and it wasn't a part of her duties, she still felt the need to make sure he wasn't manipulating the girls in class. What little she knew about him showed that he was fairly kind, so that was a point in his favor. Rather handsome too...*
